_about: Packaging Engineering: the Rutgers program, packaging societies, scholarships, competitions, and employers (researched 2026-11-16).

resources.name: Rutgers Packaging Engineering
resources.summary: Rutgers–New Brunswick's packaging program in the School of Engineering (B.S. in Applied Sciences in Engineering, Packaging Engineering concentration), described as the only packaging program housed in a U.S. engineering school.

contact.how: Talk to the packaging undergraduate director about the curriculum and co-op timing.

verification.note: Found by web search; awaiting the next live link check.

resources.name: Packaging Engineering Co-op and Internship (14:440:498/499)
resources.summary: Credit-bearing packaging co-ops built into the Rutgers packaging schedule (alternative fall or spring plans in junior year); past students worked at Mondelēz, Johnson & Johnson, Estée Lauder, and Unilever, and some received job offers.

contact.how: Plan the co-op semester with the packaging program before junior year.

resources.name: Rutgers Undergraduate Packaging Certificate
resources.summary: A packaging credential any Rutgers–New Brunswick student can add: Introduction to Packaging Engineering plus three more packaging courses.

contact.how: Start with Introduction to Packaging Engineering (14:440:301).

resources.name: IoPP (Institute of Packaging Professionals)
resources.summary: The main U.S. packaging professional society: student membership, chapter events, scholarships, and student design competitions.

contact.how: Join as a student member on the site.

verification.note: Found by web search; awaiting the next live link check.

resources.name: IoPP Student AmeriStar Packaging Competition
resources.typicalDeadline: Spring (check the site for the current cycle)
resources.summary: Free-to-enter packaging design competition for undergraduate and graduate students; winners are shown at PACK EXPO and can advance to the WorldStar awards.

contact.how: Submit a design on the IoPP site.

resources.name: IoPP Packaging Education Scholarships
resources.summary: Scholarships for upper-division packaging students, including a $5,000 PepsiCo R&D award (a Rutgers packaging student won it in 2025) and awards up to $2,500.

verification.note: Found by web search; awaiting the next live link check.

resources.name: PMMI Foundation Scholarships (PACK EXPO)
resources.summary: Over $160,000 a year for students in packaging, processing, engineering, and mechatronics, including six $5,000 PACK EXPO scholarships; the foundation also funds student travel to PACK EXPO.

contact.how: Check the scholarship page for current eligibility and dates.

resources.name: Paperboard Packaging Alliance Student Design Challenge
resources.summary: Annual team challenge to design paper-based packaging; the top three teams present at the Paperboard Packaging Council's fall meeting, and first place won $10,500 plus $10,000 for the school in 2026.

contact.how: Download the current challenge packet and enter as a team.

resources.name: Flexible Packaging Association Student Design Challenge
resources.summary: Design a flexible package that solves a real packaging problem; open to students at FPA academic member schools, individually or in teams.

contact.how: Check whether Rutgers is an FPA academic member, then submit a concept outline.
